release_rule: No delivery code, queue mutation, contact-form submission, or follow-up job may run until the owner explicitly approves the named recipients and provides the T0 release timestamp in a future task.
execution_order: Record the explicit owner approval and T0 release timestamp.
Recheck each approved recipient against bounce suppression, historic delivery state, and a live MX lookup immediately before delivery.
Deliver the initial template only when all three checks pass and sendUserEmail confirms success.
Record the actual delivery outcome before calculating follow-up timing.
Schedule follow-up one for three calendar days after a confirmed initial delivery, provided there is no unsubscribe, bounce, reply-based stop, or suppression event.
Schedule follow-up two for seven calendar days after a confirmed initial delivery, subject to the same checks and the two-reminder weekly limit.
Log every skip, failure, successful delivery, and stop condition.

schedule_binding.follow_up_1: T0 + 3 calendar days after confirmed initial delivery
schedule_binding.follow_up_2: T0 + 7 calendar days after confirmed initial delivery

template_lock.changes_require: a separately reviewed commit before release
